05 / IMPLEMENTATION ENGINEERING + AI

From production noise
to engineering signal.

Implementation work produces API payloads, logs, configuration, SQL results, test evidence, and user reports. I’m interested in using AI to shorten the path from raw context to an actionable engineering decision—while keeping deterministic verification in the loop.

Customer report“My integration isn’t working.”
→
Context collectionAPI · logs · SQL · config · network
→
AI-assisted synthesisCompare evidence · generate hypotheses
→
Deterministic checkscurl · Postman · SQL · logs · reproduce
→

AI accelerates investigation. It does not replace verification.
